column1: # Candidate SMT3 (SLUS_209.11) translation-unit ranges, with what became of each.
# Columns 1-13 are tools/pair_dds1.py's output: SLUS_209.11 functions paired
# one-to-one against byte-identical SLUS_209.74 (DDS1) functions with relocations
# and jump targets masked, then dds-decomp's DDS1 unit names carried back along
# those pairs. The names are dds-decomp's, projected there from a Nocturne
# Dec 26 2002 debug build's __FILE__ strings, so they are this game's own source
# paths. Columns 14-22 are tools/compare_boundaries.py's: what the splat config
# ended up with and whether config/smt3/tu_evidence.tsv backs it. Method, verdicts
# and the six resolved disputes: docs/tu-recovery.md.
# `newdata/datCalc` is a 60th applied unit with no row here: pair_dds1.py reached
# none of its functions, and it was placed from the HD source map alone
#   start           first SMT3 vram labelled for this unit
#   end             last SMT3 vram labelled for this unit (a function start, not its end)
#   unit            dds-decomp unit name (directory/file, no extension)
#   labelled        SMT3 functions in [start, end] carrying this label
#   functions       all SMT3 functions in [start, end]
#   contradictions  functions in that span labelled for a different unit
#   status          pair_dds1.py's own verdict: candidate (no contradictions) or
#                   rejected. Not the application outcome; see disposition
#   hd              agree / near / mixed / disagree / no-hd, from SMT3 HD source names
#   hd_source       the HD source file most of the span's functions came from
#   hd_agree        of the span's HD-known functions, how many name this unit
#   hd_known        how many of the span's functions have an HD source name
#   hd_files        distinct HD source files in the span; above 1 the range is too wide
#   note            first contradicting address and the units it belongs to
#   disposition     applied (the subsegment contains this span), superseded (it was
#                   narrowed or moved off this span), not-applied
#   applied_start   the `c` subsegment vram in config/smt3/SLUS_209.11.yaml
#   applied_end     the next subsegment's vram, so the span is [start, end)
#   support         tu_evidence.tsv at applied_start, binary-only rules only
#                   (dup-string, core-edge, dup-func): supported (a row sits there),
#                   silent (no row), echo (only hd-source or prefix rows, which read
#                   the same HD map the applied start was chosen from, so they are
#                   one witness twice), contradicted (a subsegment edge cuts a
#                   same-unit group, which the shared data proves cannot happen)
#   support_kinds   the tu_evidence.tsv kinds at applied_start
#   hd_fit          how the HD source run at applied_start lines up: name+start+end,
#                   name+start, start (name differs), near (HD name is a suffix of
#                   this one), disagree, none (HD names nothing there)
#   witnesses       independent sources agreeing on applied_start. dds1 is this file;
#                   hd is the HD source map, which shares no input with it; binary is
#   action          keep / move-start / move-end / widen-start / narrow-end / defer
#   action_note     why, when the action is not keep
